name: RustFS

evidence.files: C02: self-hosted object and file storage through an S3-compatible API; F05: tested S3 subset

line: Self-hosted S3-compatible object storage with versioning and bucket policies.

free.text: Apache-2.0; no vendor quota or idle rule; you supply disks and retention

cells.metered: No service fee; hosting, disks, and network cost extra

sql.math: RustFS provides object storage, not a database
RustFS provides object storage, not a database

files.math: The software is Apache-2.0, a free open-source license. The costs for 100 GB of disks, host, power and network depend on your setup.

jobs.math: RustFS does not run background jobs
